# Dragonborn
## General Information
Dragonborn are a [color=lightgreen]sub-species of human[/color], born from the early stages of advanced genetic modification. They loosely resemble reptilians, but [color=palevioletred]are not, and cannot use their tails to drag objects[/color].
Dragonborn deal a mixture of [color=lightgreen]slash and blunt[/color] damage with their unarmed attack.
Due to thickened skin and scales on their limbs, dragonborn take [color=lightgreen]20% less blunt and piercing[/color], but take [color=palevioletred]10% more cold damage[/color] due to errors in their genetics.
They have similar digestion to reptilians.
